info.title: MagicPitch showroom integration boundary
info.description: Contract specification; foundation does not implement routes. One authoritative FinalProject session, full MoviePart studio, scoped Windows bridge. Legacy dedicated-media v1 unchanged.

deviceBearer.description: Local operator setup only; never a browser long-lived secret

sessionBearer.description: Short-lived session capability redeemed from one-time kiosk code; in-memory only

operatorBearer.description: Short-lived bridge:lease grant scoped to one bridge; not a bridge connection credential
